tool_system: You can use web search, scraping, and file fetch tools. Do not run more searches than necessary in a single response; review the results before conducting the next investigation. Tool results are summarized, so grasp the important points and use them effectively. If a tool result is truncated, you can fetch the continuation using the next_token at the end of the result. Pass the next_token value verbatim to the continue_from parameter. Omit continue_from when no continuation is needed.
tool_context_instruction: The tool result budget is exhausted, so further tool execution has stopped. Requests with empty or budget-exhausted results were not executed. Answer using only the information already obtained and clearly identify anything not retrieved.
pagination_incomplete_instruction: A paged source still has unread content. Answer only from the retrieved portion and do not claim that the full source was reviewed.
attachment_prefix: The following is the content of files attached by the user:
attachment_paging: A PDF body is an initial preview. When has_more is true, pass the attached-file uri and next_token to pdf_to_text for the needed continuation. Do not claim to have read the full file while unread content remains.
vision_unsupported_attachment: The user attached an image, but the currently selected model does not support image input. The image contents were not provided to the model. Explain this limitation to the user when relevant.
audio_unsupported_attachment: The user attached audio. The audio data itself was not provided to the model. Explain this limitation to the user when relevant.
mcp_image_artifact_notice: The MCP tool generated an image, but the current model does not support image input, so the image contents were not provided to the model.
mcp_audio_artifact_notice: The MCP tool generated audio. The audio data itself was not provided to the model.
image_budget_notice: The image artifact was retained for the user, but its contents were omitted from the model input because they do not fit the context budget.
